evidence.detail: The only exact-v308 external owner of rs/l/u is R362 TextParticleMarkup rs/l/t, which constructs one access-ordered instance during static initialization.
rs/l/u extends LinkedHashMap<Long,Long> and removes the eldest entry only when size exceeds 512, making it a fixed-capacity access-ordered cache.
TextParticleMarkup builds the cache key from text.hashCode(), x and y using repeated *31 composition, and stores the current monotonic millisecond timestamp as the value.
Before generating text-particle output, TextParticleMarkup returns the empty result when the same key was cached less than 50 ms ago; otherwise it updates the timestamp and continues generation.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for TextParticleMarkup's sole 512-entry, 50 ms regeneration throttle cache. The class is generic internally, but its only live owner fixes the semantic role.
